analysis.second_pass: Take E = R, m = 0, k = 0, P = [-1,1] and Q = {1}. This is a general (1,0)-ball pair; properness is not required by the bound source. A PL 0-sphere L consists of two distinct points. Radial injectivity forces the cone apex p to lie strictly between them. Since J is a subcomplex of L and p is not in L, a singleton cone on J forces J.space to be empty and the subcone to be {p}. Thus its image under a homeomorphism of the ambient interval is an interior point, not the endpoint 1. Piecewise affine maps on the finite closed local covers in IsPLHomeomorphOn are continuous on their domains, so the endpoint argument applies. This is a mathematical separating example, not a claimed Lean-certified counterexample.
